name: Alpbach Klassik Festival
beschreibung: Renowned orchestras and soloists perform classical masterpieces in the unique acoustics of the Alpbacher Congress Centrum against a panoramic mountain backdrop. The festival combines top-tier classical music with the idyllic scenery of Austria's most beautiful village.
kurzbeschreibung: Classical masterpieces in Austria's most beautiful village – featuring mountain panoramas and world-class orchestras.
